name: Regolith
description: A grey lunar surface pocked with craters of every size, each a raised rim with its inner wall in shadow on the side the light comes from.

code.style: --rule: ( --s: @calc(@rn(0.35, 1.5, 1.3) * @r(0.45, 1.3)); --jx: @r(-22%, 22%); --jy: @r(-22%, 22%); z-index: @calc(round(120 - $(s) * 60)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: radial-gradient(circle at @r(6, 94)% @r(6, 94)%, var(--color2) 0 2%, transparent 2.6%), radial-gradient(circle at @r(6, 94)% @r(6, 94)%, var(--color1) 0 1.6%, transparent 2.2%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color3)); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 38% 38% at 50% 50%, transparent 100%, #000 100%); transform: translate(@var(--jx), @var(--jy)) scale(@var(--s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color2); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 38% 38% at 50% 50%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 38% 38% at 60% 60%, transparent 100%, #000 100%); mask-composite: intersect; transform: translate(@var(--jx), @var(--jy)) scale(@var(--s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
